name: Terrain blocks (p306)
description: p306 Phase 2's verification scene: three 100 m terrain blocks side by side, spawned with spawnTerrainBlock. Middle: the Gym's terrainSmooth.glb as a JSON-only block (an imported node, a HEIGHTFIELD read from its geometry, grass through its materialInputs' variant of textureSetSurface). Right: a generated block (the toolkit's noiseTerrain) with the generator's heightfield. Left: a generated block with a TRIMESH collider. A 3 × 3 grid of boxes falls on each. window.__terrainBlockTest holds the spawn results and, after the boxes settle, each box's height above the terrain under it.
